title: Finite scalar mate on the ordinary Tate tensor generators
statement: For T Noetherian, prime ell invertible on T, d>=0 and a<=b, and any generator-normalized CoefficientLineComparison r, the adjunct of scalarComparison followed by derivedRealization(proTwistMap d r), after restriction to the completed coefficient ring and the canonical exact single-model comparisons finiteModelIso, is the single image in degree -2d of an ordinary sheaf map f satisfying FiniteRootTransition. No integral root tensor, balanced identification or AdicTower is quantified.

source.place: Adic-stage compatibility with finite coefficient reductions; the ordinary root-tensor and scalar-mate computation in the proof of lem-pur-tate-tensor-normalized-square-pair.

proof.text: Replace the finite derived twists by their specified single ordinary models. Exact restriction commutes with the single embedding; fullness supplies the ordinary map. At d=0 the unit comparison is scalar multiplication. At a root factor use derived_normalization and generators of r; tensorPowerStep propagates the formula in d through the scalar tensorator and even shifts. The site/scalar and realization/scalar maps are identity-normalized adjunction mates, so preserve the sheafification generators and send t,s,z to q(t),phi(s),r.roots(z).

lean.statement:
theorem finiteTateTensor_transition_model
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (r : CoefficientLineComparison
      (FiniteReduction.quotient.{u} ell (Nat.add_le_add_right hab 1))
      (ell ^ (b + 1)) (ell ^ (a + 1))
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) (CharP.cast_eq_zero _ _) T) :
    ∃ f : (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).obj
        ((realization T ell b).obj (finiteSheaf T ell b d)) ⟶
      (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)).obj
        ((realization T ell a).obj (finiteSheaf T ell a d)),
      FiniteRootTransition T ell d b a hab r f ∧
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).map
          ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).homEquiv
            _ _ ((scalarComparison T ell b a hab).hom.app (finiteTwist T ell b d) ≫
              (derivedRealization T ell a).map (proTwistMap d r))) ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrictComp (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)
          (pbcAdicQuotient T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)
          (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)
          (pbcAdicProjection_comp T (datum.{u} ell) b a hab)).hom.app _ ≫
        (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)).map
          (finiteModelIso T ell hT a d).hom ≫
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
          (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) a)) (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).hom.app _ =
      (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)).map
          (finiteModelIso T ell hT b d).hom ≫
        (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
          (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) b)) (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).hom.app _ ≫
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).map f
